buildWarnings: Bundled third-party OFD library retains existing NaN-comparison and instanceof-precedence warnings.
Offline IIFE and embedded photos/fonts create a large bundle; no network CDN is required for them.
limitations: No APK/HAP was generated, signed, uploaded or installed by this pass. The user submits cloud builds in HBuilderX.
Sandboxed Chromium and deterministic native-host simulation do not replace Android/HarmonyOS device installation and upgrade validation.
Account/cloud/conversion availability depends on actual authentication, permissions and configured service capabilities; no production account operations are claimed by these offline tests.
Unsupported formulas, spill arrays, external data, macros, ambiguous date text and third-party object/font fidelity remain bounded by the documented support list and import warnings.
